title: Why? #2: why 7 comes up most with two dice → NDA 2026 (II) Q111 (44 s, continuous motion)

captions.instagram:
Why? #2 · Why does 7 come up most with two dice? 🎲

Two dice give 36 equally likely outcomes. Write the sum in each box of the 6×6 grid and every sum sits on one diagonal. 7's diagonal is the longest: 6 ways out of 36. Every other sum has fewer.

NDA 2026 (II) asked it (Maths Q111): P(sum is neither 5 nor 7) = ?
Sum 5 has 4 ways, sum 7 has 6 ways → 36 − 4 − 6 = 26 left → 26/36 = 13/18 → (c).
Trap: (d) 5/6 only removes the 7s.
